# Phenomiq

> Phenomiq is a web design and development studio in Abeokuta, Ogun State, Nigeria. It builds fast, mobile-first websites, online stores, booking and payment systems, SEO and brand identity for businesses and professionals across Nigeria. Tagline: Design. Develop. Deliver.

Typical delivery: websites go live in 7 to 10 days. Written quotes are sent within 24 hours of an enquiry.

## Pages
- [Home](https://phenomiq.com.ng/): services, recent projects, how we work, questions and contact form.

## Services
- Websites for businesses
- Bookings, forms and payments (Paystack, Flutterwave, receipts)
- Online stores (catalogue, cart, checkout, WhatsApp ordering)
- SEO and Google visibility
- Brand identity
